This is a small local smoke stream. It checks the next token loop, not language quality. The phase state continues from one sentence to the next sentence.
The model predicts before the next token arrives. The observed token then provides the next force. Training and deployment use the same event order.
Two continuous velocities collide while preserving their total momentum and kinetic energy. The particles keep their positions during a collision.
Information enters through the force and the initial joint density. The decoder reads only the evolved distribution. There is no direct token shortcut.
This finite text is a test fixture. It is not OpenWebText and its loss is not an OpenWebText benchmark. Checkpoints preserve the stream cursor and phase state.
